about: The fixed case set of lib/learnings.js INSTRUCTIONS (tools/prompt-cases.json set learnings; plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-28-what-we-learned.md PR B2): one filled form judged against kept learnings. Each answer has the verdict it must get (accept: the verdicts also right), the topic it must pick when it names one, and words its new question must hold. Owner, 28 Oct 2026: the AI decides same / extends / conflicts / new; Strategy owns employment type; never right to work, criminal record or demographics; a per-company question is never learned; salary per country.
